description.value: Heaven Sushi + Sake Bar is an Asian fusion restaurant situated in Kamloops' Aberdeen hotel district, offering sushi, sashimi, and Japanese-Western fusion dishes alongside an extensive sake list, wine selection, and cocktails. Diners choose their own handcrafted sake cup, adding a personal touch to the experience. It also serves a breakfast brunch menu, making it a versatile stop for touring cyclists at multiple points in the day.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at heavenkamloops.com is fully active and confirms the address (1175 Rogers Way, Kamloops, BC V1S 1R5) and provides a phone number (236) 425-0050 and email not present in OSM tags. The homepage includes an 'ORDER NOW' button, confirming takeout is available. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those fields are null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; (236) 425-0050 sourced from website only. Website renders it as '236) 425-0050' (missing opening parenthesis) — likely a display typo.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functioning website, confirmed address, and publicly accessible dining. A solid food stop for touring cyclists in Kamloops.
